title: Penthouse August 1992 Jean-Claude Van Damme Cover Complete w/ Centerfold
conditionDescription: Complete w/ centerfold. Covers clean and bright with light handling wear; spine intact. See photos.
descriptionText:
Penthouse magazine, August 1992, original $4.95 cover price. Complete w/ Centerfold. Jean-Claude Van Damme cover - "Kicks Up a Storm." Pet: Tammy Chapman.

Cover features: Dino's Demons - Dean Martin's bizarre self-destruction; Sen. Jay Rockefeller on George Bush; Alan Dershowitz; Ed Koch's summer survival guide to New York City; Karen DeCrow.

Back cover: Montclair cigarette ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
